tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
tenderSchedule.locationName: KBOCWWB CEO and Secretary Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Joint Secretary, 1st Floor, Kalyana Suraksha Bhavana, Bannerghatta Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Other conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have an experience in the similar nature of service mentioned in the tender with a project value of minimum Rs. 19.00 Lakhs in any Central/ State Government/ Boards/ PSUs in the preceding 5 years.
The Bidder Should have Completed or Ongoing similar nature of service mentioned in the tender to minimum 2 Central/ State Government/ Boards/PSUs in the preceding 5 years.
The Firm should be in existence for at least 3 Years having a valid registration certificate issued by any of the departments in the State of Karnataka.
The Technical approach, Methodology, Work Plan, Organization and staffing for Performing the Assignment (Through Presentation).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have average annual turnover of minimum Rs. 76.00 Lakhs for the last 3 financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder Name and Address with contact details to be uploaded.
Bidder should have average annual turnover of minimum Rs. 76.00 Lakhs for the last 3 financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Submission of Declaration of Acceptance of Terms & Conditions to Tender in the given format.
The Bidder should be a firm or organization registered under Appropriate Government entity and shall be existence for at least 3 Years from the date of submission of Bid.

The Bidder should have an experience in the similar nature of service mentioned in the tender with a project value of minimum Rs. 19.00 Lakhs in any Central/ State Government/ Boards/ PSUs in the preceding 5 years.
The Bidder Should have Completed or Ongoing similar nature of service mentioned in the tender to minimum 2 Central/ State Government/ Boards/ PSUs in the preceding 5 years.
The Bidder should have ISO 9001 2015 or Latest

The Bidder should not be blacklisted by the Government of Karnataka or any of its department/agency or by Central / any other State/UT Government or its department/ agency for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices for any reasons whatsoever as on the time of bidding.
The Bidder should submit a declaration for having an office in Karnataka.
